articles.title: Siri AI's Biggest Upgrade Yet + John Ternus's First Apple Earnings Call
articles.content: Apple is finally bringing some of Siri's most ambitious AI capabilities to the iPhone. In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov break down the major changes coming with iOS 27.3, including Siri's new ability to control apps, carry out complex tasks and coordinate actions across multiple applications. They discuss how these improvements compare with AI agents from OpenAI and Meta, and why Apple still has a long way to go. Plus, Mark and Vlad analyze John Ternus's first earnings call as Apple's CEO, the company's strong iPhone sales, concerns about slowing growth and profit margins, and why more price increases could be coming. They also examine Apple's AI rollout in China and the privacy implications of new always-listening Apple Watch features. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
